title: Water: Captain Bucket

lines.speaker: BUBBLES
lines.text: The bucket has applied for the position of warship.
directions: [board: a bucket with a paper sail, parked on the candidate chair. Two more chairs behind it, lettered HIRED and NOT HIRED, both empty. Sign above: WATER DEPARTMENT. Smaller sign under it: ELEMENTS CHANGE ATTACK. NEVER DEFENSE. Game board unchanged.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Speed one. It has applied for a very slow war.

lines.speaker: BUBBLES
lines.text: The bucket has a sail, a captain, and the best shield in the department. We are ready for anything.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Last time the Hi on C three finished an Inyan. What did Fire add?
directions: [card: THE THREE QUESTIONS. Which stat helps this job? How many actions does it take? What will this piece owe next turn?]
[card: ROSTER KEY. Hit = base attack before elements. Shield = full defense. Walk = squares per action. Take = maximum crystals at own turn end, limited by reserve. Keep beside every roster recital.]
[card: C three, and the Hi who lives there]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Plus one against Metal. Today the Deep End puts out the Sparks. Water takes one away.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: One job. Two pieces want it. First up is the Sjor.
directions: [card: THE JOB. Survive two Hi for one whole turn.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The Hi has attack two. Water beats Fire, so take one away.
directions: [board: BOARD ONE. Two fresh Hi standing beside a fresh Sjor. Every other card dim.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Each Hi does one damage. A fresh Sjor has defense two.
directions: [card: each Hi, one damage] [card: the Sjor, defense two]

lines.speaker: BUBBLES
lines.text: One, then one. Not hired. The shield was one short.
directions: [sfx: bonk] [sfx: bonk] [sfx: piece removed] [board: the Sjor tips into the tray. The bucket moves to the NOT HIRED chair.]

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: New piece. New turn. Two fresh Hi again. A fresh Straumr has defense three.
directions: [board: BOARD TWO. A fresh position. Two fresh Hi, neither used yet. A fresh Straumr where the Sjor stood.] [card: the Straumr, defense three]

lines.speaker: BUBBLES
lines.text: The same two Hi. Does my Straumr survive the turn?

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Remember the Bonk Lab dare? This is it. Count it, or watch the board with me.
lines.question: The same two Hi. Does my Straumr survive the turn?

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The Straumr is standing. One defense left.
directions: [sfx: bonk, dull] [sfx: bonk, dull] [board: the damage marker climbs to two. The Straumr is still standing. Both Hi grey out.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Neither Hi finished it. Each of them is done attacking for the turn.

lines.speaker: BUBBLES
lines.text: The shield held. Two attackers were not enough. That is a crewing problem.

lines.speaker: BUBBLES
lines.text: Two buckets is not the whole navy.
directions: [card: EVIDENCE. Proves: two Hi against one Straumr. Not checked: a third attacker, and Black's reply.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: I do not know what Black brings to this square next. We have not counted that.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Big shield. Slow boat.
directions: [card: THE HELMET'S FILE. Bucket safety sticker: awarded. Defense: unchanged.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Defense three, and one square per action.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Turned down for one job. Hired for another. I am putting that on a sticker.
directions: [card: the Sjor · the Straumr · the Aegirinn.]

lines.speaker: BUBBLES
lines.text: This is the Sjor. Shield of two. Takes two crystals. That is the Sjor.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: At your own turn end it takes from the square it is standing on.
directions: [board: a Sjor standing on a square holding four crystals] [card: this square, four crystals] [card: INCOME. At your own turn end. From the square you are standing on. Never the square you left.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Mining two. Four crystals here. Took two. Two left.
directions: [sfx: crystal clink] [sfx: crystal clink] [board: four becomes two]

lines.speaker: BUBBLES
lines.text: This is the Aegirinn. Shield of four. Takes three. That is the Aegirinn.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Next turn the Sjor owes nothing. The Straumr owes one. The Aegirinn owes two.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Big shield. Slow boat.
directions: [card: WATER WORK CARD. Defense two, three, four · speed one, one, two · Mining two, two, three · toll nothing, one, two. Added to the deck.]

lines.speaker: BUBBLES
lines.text: The captain is aware of the boat situation.
directions: [board: the paper sail slumps sideways into the bucket]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Now the bonk matrix for water. We check all eighteen enemy unit types, including matching types. Both pieces start at full health and are already next to each other. One attack, not a whole turn.

supplement.title: Read one tier at a time
supplement.body:
Green: this unit one-shots the enemy.
Red: that enemy one-shots this unit.
Both at full health · adjacent · one legal attack.
This is damage, not a movement or safety prediction.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Tier one: the Sjor. Attack two, defense two, speed one, and Mining two. Look at the green side first.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: With one attack, the Sjor can finish Hi, Hono, Kagari, Radi, Umeme, Kimubunga, Sjor, Göl, Gölge and Karanlık. Every unlit card survives that single hit.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Now the red side. A full health Sjor is one shot by Hono, Kagari, Kimubunga, Sjor, Straumr, Aegirinn, Göl, Gölge, Karanlık, Sachita, Sachakuna, Inyan, Mazask and Tanka. Every unlit attacker needs help or earlier damage.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: That is the tier one card. Pause here to compare any names. The same enemy can appear on both sides: whoever attacks first may finish the other.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Tier two: the Straumr. Attack two, defense three, speed one, and Mining two. Look at the green side first.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: With one attack, the Straumr can finish Hi, Hono, Kagari, Radi, Umeme, Kimubunga, Sjor, Göl, Gölge and Karanlık. Every unlit card survives that single hit.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Now the red side. A full health Straumr is one shot by Kagari, Aegirinn, Gölge, Karanlık, Sachakuna, Mazask and Tanka. Every unlit attacker needs help or earlier damage.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: That is the tier two card. Pause here to compare any names. The same enemy can appear on both sides: whoever attacks first may finish the other.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Tier three: the Aegirinn. Attack three, defense four, speed two, and Mining three. Look at the green side first.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: With one attack, the Aegirinn can finish Hi, Hono, Kagari, Radi, Umeme, Kimubunga, Sjor, Straumr, Göl, Gölge, Karanlık. Every unlit card survives that single hit.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Now the red side. A full health Aegirinn is one shot by Karanlık. Every unlit attacker needs help or earlier damage.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: That is the tier three card. Pause here to compare any names. The same enemy can appear on both sides: whoever attacks first may finish the other.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: A dare. Give the bucket one job for one turn. Stopping here is fine.

lines.speaker: BUBBLES
lines.text: Two was not enough. I am recruiting for life.
